units: <cite ref="Zevachim 116a:10-22">Zeb. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … אחזתן ר׳ וכ׳</he> trembling seized all the kings of the nations in their palaces.

Tosef. Zab. IV, 6 כל שבא … מכח ר׳ וכ׳ whatever indirect contact is produced by vibration is clean, opp. הסטה, v. הֶיסֵּט.—Pl. רְעָדוֹת questions of levitical cleanness based on indirect contact through vibration.
